gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.0: A soap bubble with a letter in it is floating your way. Click it to pop it.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.1: Fly to Bikini Bottom with Appa (in his menu, under the other places) or follow the Super Compass (the end tab). Land on the little island above the big soap bubble.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.2: On the little island, step into the bubble stream that bubbles downwards. It sets you down gently on the square of Bikini Bottom.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.3: Walk east from the square to The Krusty Nibble (the door is on the main street). Talk to Mr. Krabguh.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.4: Stand behind the grill in the kitchen. Customers order at the order tables: look at the ticket and stack the patty in the right order. Five good orders and you are a real nibble cook.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.nu.4_b: Start baking! Look at the ticket to see what the customer wants and stack it in that order.
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.0: Anywhere in the Guh End (the bubble finds you)
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.1: The little island above the bubble of Bikini Bottom, deep between the outer islands of the Guh End
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.2: The bubble stream on the little island, down to the square
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.3: The Krusty Nibble, east of the square on the main street
gui.guhs.verhalen.sponsguh_recept.waar.4: The grill in the kitchen of The Krusty Nibble
